blocks.text: MANILA – The Department of Justice (DOJ) and its government and private sector partners launched the “SURE Ka Na Ba?” campaign on Thursday to raise awareness and strengthen efforts against cyber fraud. The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI), the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), and the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC), as well as private sector partners — the Kapisanan ng mga Brodkaster ng Pilipinas (KBP), Smart Communications, Globe Telecom, Maya, DITO, and BPI joined the campaign, which involves the acronym S-U-R-E that stands for “spot, understand, report, and empower.” READ: PNP ACG sees decline in online scams, cites improved awareness […]... Keep on reading: ‘SURE Ka Na Ba?’ campaign launched to help Filipinos detect online scams
